description: React component for email backup preferences, managing email backup frequency and notification settings within a user preferences UI.

methods.name: loadEmailFrequencySetting
methods.description: Loads the user's email backup frequency and mute setting from application settings.

methods.name: updateSetting
methods.description: Updates a user setting via the application settings API.

methods.name: updateEmailFrequency
methods.description: Updates the email backup frequency setting.

methods.name: toggleMuteFailedBackupEmails
methods.description: Toggles the mute setting for failed backup email notifications.

methods.name: handleEmailFrequencyChange
methods.description: Handles change in email frequency selection.
